payload.rationale: Selected from 8 validation-only trials. Building on the best prior result (resnet18 depth=3, hidden=32, lr=0.0005 → 99.16% acc), this candidate increases capacity moderately: depth 3→4 adds one more residual block for richer feature hierarchy, and hidden 32→48 widens channels by 50% to capture more discriminative pathology features. The LR is reduced to 0.0003 to maintain training stability with the larger parameter count (roughly 1.5-2x more params). rotate90 is added as a third conservative geometric augmentation (alongside hflip and vflip) to provide orientation invariance without destroying tissue-orientation cues. All other hyperparameters (adamw, cosine, wd=1e-4, ls=0.05, batch=128, dropout=0.1, standardize) are held constant to isolate the effect of the capacity and augmentation changes. The 1.63x class imbalance is mild enough that class_weighting is unnecessary; label_smoothing=0.05 provides sufficient regularization.
